name: opendss_altdss_library

support_targets.opendss: EPRI OpenDSS; online documentation is mixed-version

validation.source_review: Line/LineCode, Phase 3A and Phase 3B packages 1 through 6 passed independent QA/QC and architect review and are accepted. Phase 4 package 4.1 (fixture harness and snapshot goldens) passed coder validation, independent QA/QC (PASS, no required corrections) and the architect review (PASS WITH FINDINGS: E-1 per-element loss semantics clarified in the Phase 4 design, O-1 to O-4 recorded) and is accepted by the owner (decision 16), which freezes the fixture pin and both revision 1 goldens as fixed reference data. Fixture inputs are byte-identical to electricdss-tst @ 3b20839 in both the working tree and the repository blobs, and both revision 1 goldens reproduce on the pinned stack. Phase 4 package 4.2 (RegControl catalog) is issued to the coder; its property surface, constructor defaults and fourteen behaviour traps were verified on the pinned stack before the handoff.
validation.schema_validation: The Phase 4.1 validation run passed 15/15 manifest and catalog schema pairs, and the current run passes 16/16 (Draft 2020-12 with format checking, jsonschema 4.26.0); the architect review re-ran it at the same result on 2026-11-21 local. Package 4.2 adds the RegControl catalog as the seventeenth pair.
validation.runtime: All 14 catalogued examples passed on the pinned stack, and both IEEE snapshot fixtures pass against their revision 1 goldens (ieee13: 16 buses, 38 elements, 2 total iterations; ieee34: 37 buses, 117 elements, 25 total and 6 control iterations). The architect review re-ran both harnesses at 2026-11-21 local and reproduced the recorded golden hashes.

known_gaps: Three catalog files are still empty pending later phases: opendss_objects, python_interface_comparison, troubleshooting.

The generated altdss_python_api catalog covers object and collection classes and the AltDSS context. Non-element context interfaces, context batch proxies, and internal _str proxies are outside the catalog scope.

dss_capi.json covers Line, LineCode, LineGeometry, LineSpacing, WireData, CNData, TSData, Circuit creation, Vsource, Transformer, XfmrCode, Load, Capacitor, and Generator, including inherited fields used in these packages.
Transformer and XfmrCode coverage is limited to two and three windings. AutoTrans is deferred pending an owner scope decision.
LoadShape and GrowthShape property catalogs are deferred. The Load package covers the Load element and its shape-assignment behavior only.
Property-level source_refs remain partial for Line/LineCode (E-3 deferred); new element packages require per-row citations.
Fixture-based validation with IEEE 13- and 34-node circuits and golden results is planned for Phase 4; no golden fixtures exist yet.
The beta package line (AltDSS-Python 0.3.0b2 and later) is documented as future compatibility only and not validated.
EPRI online pages do not state one OpenDSS version; version-sensitive claims need release-specific confirmation.
The legacy line catalog and builder are retained for provenance and are not active inputs.
CapControl is a deferred controller catalog. The Capacitor package covers the Capacitor element and the States control hook only.
The Capacitor element has no Spectrum property, unlike Load and Vsource.

The shared element schema now declares enum_type, reference_class, and dss_text_keyword. Optional array and write-path metadata cited in Capacitor architect finding O-1 still needs shared schema declarations.
GenDispatcher, CapControl, InvControl, PVSystem and Storage are deferred controller or element catalogs; the element packages cover element behavior and control hooks only.

Generator's built-in dispatch settings and separate GenDispatcher control are source-reviewed. The Model 3 snapshots use the default PVFactor; sensitivity to changing it is source-reviewed. Compiled models, dynamic studies, harmonics, and fuel consumption are outside runtime scope.

RegControl, CapControl, GenDispatcher, LoadShape, GrowthShape, PVSystem, Storage and AutoTrans remain uncatalogued; RegControl is scheduled for Phase 4 package 4.2, the others are pending an owner scope decision.
next_actions: Phase 4 package 4.1 (fixture harness and snapshot goldens) is accepted by the owner (decision 16). The fixture pin and both revision 1 goldens are now fixed reference data: later packages may add goldens but must not change the fixture bytes or revision 1, and any change that moves a golden value requires a new revision with a recorded reason. E-1 stays closed by document, so no package change is required.

Deliver Phase 4 package 4.2 (RegControl catalog) per the Phase 3 six-artifact template; the coder handoff is issued with the verified property surface, constructor defaults, unit flags and fourteen probed traps, and the goldens already carry regulator tap positions for both fixtures. Independent QA/QC follows the coder build.
Deliver phase 4 packages 4.3 (daily time series on ieee13), 4.4 (cross-interface tool with opendssdirect 0.9.4) and 4.5 (exit: troubleshooting.json, manifest and documentation reconciliation).
Decide and record the remaining deferred class catalogs (CapControl, GenDispatcher, LoadShape, GrowthShape, PVSystem, Storage) and AutoTrans: catalogue in a later package or record as out of scope.
